photos.title: The Preserve at Pine Lakes from above
photos.what: The Preserve at Pine Lakes from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): streets of houses in four phases, dark ponds between the street loops, a golf course along the east side, and a pool and play area on common land.
photos.caption: The Preserve at Pine Lakes from the air. The golf course runs along the right edge.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of The Preserve at Pine Lakes in Myrtle Beach: curving streets of houses, ponds between the street loops, and a golf course along the right edge
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023 (flight tile m_3307818_nw_17_060_20230410), natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling) on 2026-11-17; the exact request is in source_request. The image service identify call at the frame returns the 2023 tile.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the NAIP records of /submarkets/garden-city/ (data/2026-11-a/submarkets-garden-city/photos.json): The National Map offers free downloads of public domain NAIP orthoimagery; the USDA FSA policy page says public domain information may be freely distributed or copied, with credit requested.
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS).
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty cut this view from the NAIP service (4:3)
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /submarkets/myrtle-beach/pine-lakes-preserve/ on 2026-11-17. The frame is the community's four phases, with a highway interchange to the west and a golf course to the east. No person; no readable sign, plate or house number at page size.
photos.crop_note: The 1x1, 4x3 and 16x9 share crops are center crops of the same 1800x1350 export.
